senses.title: 为了；以便
senses.usageNote: 短语，用于说明某个动作的目的。

examples.en: She studied hard so as to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 她努力学习以便通过考试。

examples.en: They left early so as to arrive on time.
examples.zh: 他们提前出发，以便准时到达。

collocations.en: so as to arrive on time

relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: so as to 与 because

example.en: She studied so as to pass.
She studied because she was curious.

confusions.takeaway: 结合语境区分，不能一概互换。
